task.title: webhook events don't carry scheduled_at for held/scheduled sends (#815 follow-up)
task.body:
## What

Since #833 ("preserve send_at across a review hold"), a held message that carried a future `send_at` is re-armed on approval: it returns `status=scheduled` with `scheduled_at` on the HTTP surfaces (send response, approve response, review queue, message detail) and actually submits at that instant.

But the async webhook events are not extended:

- `email.review_requested` (`buildPendingApprovalEvent` in `internal/agent/webhooks_api.go`) — no `scheduled_at`, even though a future `send_at` was stamped on the held draft.
- `email.review_approved` (`buildApprovedEvent`) — no `scheduled_at`, so a subscriber cannot tell whether approval re-armed the schedule or is sending immediately.

The events themselves fire correctly and on time (`review_approved` at approval, `email.sent` at the scheduled instant) — this is purely a payload-surface gap.

## Why it is worth closing

A reviewer that drives review asynchronously via webhooks (an automated approver, a queue consumer, a compliance workflow) receives `email.review_approved` with no way to know the message was deferred to `scheduled_at` vs. delivered now. Today they would have to go back and `GET /v1/messages/{id}` to discover it. Both features are beta, so this is an additive (optional field) change with no compatibility cost.

## Fix

Add optional `scheduled_at` (RFC 3339, `x-stability-level: beta`) to the `email.review_requested` and `email.review_approved` event payloads when the message carries a schedule:

1. `buildPendingApprovalEvent`: include `msg.ScheduledAt` (the row already has it after the hold stamps it).
2. `buildApprovedEvent`: include `sent.ScheduledAt` — present when approval re-armed the schedule; note it stays set on the row after the instant passes, so document "set when the message was scheduled; retained afterwards".
3. Regenerate / update the OpenAPI + generated SDK event models, and cover with a webhook-payload test (e.g. in `internal/agent/webhooks_events_test.go`).

Follow-up to #815 / #833.
